title: Lacson to investigate P5M allocation fund allegedly offered by Tesda

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Saturday revealed that he “unequivocally” turned down a P5-million worth of allocation fund allegedly offered by the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (Tesda). Lacson said that he will seek an explanation on the matter when the Senate debates on Tesda’s proposed budget for 2027 in the plenary in November. READ: Tesda: 230,000 scholarship slots may be cut in 2027 due to budget slash “When TESDA’s proposed 2027 budget comes up for plenary debate, I will seek clarification on the P5-million fund offer made to me through my Senate staff early this week,” […]...
